what_to_detect: A decision candidate that turns a face-down permanent face up through its Morph keyword line (the morph cost) is playable, where the permanent is a manifested card with morph.
near_miss: A face-down manifested permanent whose card has no morph has no Morph candidate, only the mana-cost face-up action.
record_fields: decision candidate keys (a morph face-up ability keys to the card's Morph keyword line)

what_to_detect: A decision candidate that turns a face-down permanent face up through its Disguise keyword line (the disguise cost) is playable, where the permanent is a manifested card with disguise.
near_miss: A face-down manifested permanent whose card has no disguise has no Disguise candidate, only the mana-cost face-up action.
record_fields: decision candidate keys (a disguise face-up ability keys to the card's Disguise keyword line)

what_to_detect: A turn-face-up resolution (SetState with Mode$ TurnFaceUp) turns a face-down permanent face up, writing a face_change to face_up.
near_miss: A turn-face-up resolution writes no face_change: the manifested instant or sorcery card is revealed and stays face down, and no turned-face-up trigger runs.
